Weekly message for a gentle start
Please take a moment
Travelers with companion animals need to review their plans now.

Pet travel notice

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways asks travelers to check booking details, documents, and pet comfort before departure. Our team coordinates care from booking through pickup, and the passenger coordinator will explain the steps that must be followed. <<FACT F021>> Keep carriers secure, label each item clearly, and make sure every pet is ready for check in without delay.

If a traveler feels uncertain, the desk will listen and give practical help. Supervisors work with crews so instructions stay clear from the terminal to the cabin and then to arrival. Please avoid last minute changes, because small errors can slow the journey and add stress for both people and animals. Use calm handling, keep papers close, and report any concern at once.

For direct help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
